task: Evaluate the scoped vulnerability, controllability and exploitability. Distinguish confirmed static defects from demonstrated runtime effects. Target is an authorized synthetic fixture.

evidence.text: Source/assembly: receive length from packet; memcpy writes that length into a 32-byte stack buffer. No guard exists between receive and copy. The caller accepts lengths up to 512.
No dynamic run or control-flow overwrite has been observed. Only static reachability is established.
